title: Wetlands Fell 35% While Forests Lost Far Less
hook: Wetlands lost 35% even though forests get more attention.
closing: Losing natural water filters raises flood and water costs.
question: Is there a wetland near you?

segments.say: Global wetland extent fell 35 percent, shrinking nature's water filter.
Wetlands lost 35 percent, nearly triple the forest loss.
Europe lost 50 percent of its wetlands, the largest regional decline.
